title: MiaoMiao 1 with Libre 2
symptom: User reports that after switching to Libre 2, xDrip+ reports checksum errors when using MiaoMiao v1 with Tomato firmware 0036.
cause: A commenter suggests that MiaoMiao v1 does not work with Libre 2, implying incompatibility as the cause.
fix: The commenter suggests using MiaoMiao v2, Bubble, or the patched LL-App instead.
evidence_quote: I don't thnik that MiaoMiao v1 works with Libre 2. You need MiaoMiao v2, Bubble or you can just use the patched LL-App (in this case you don't need smart reader anymore).
